delivery.outcome: jetbrains_chat_target_from_surface (CC=10, fan-out=8, mutations=30) becomes a thin orchestrator (CC=7, fan-out=7, mutations=4) over a decomposed pipeline: _SurfaceWindow/_CapturePoint value objects plus _surface_from_source, _surface_window_from_bounds, _surface_window_rect, _surface_coordinate_map, _clamped_surface_window, _composer_capture_point, _point_inside_capture and _surface_target_payload.
nonGoals: Change behavior, payload keys or public API.

architecture.decision: Carry the window rect and mapped point as frozen dataclasses (_SurfaceWindow with as_rect/composer_anchor, _CapturePoint) so no stage unpacks a 4-tuple (each unpack counts 8 mutations in code2llm). Split the orchestrator into named stages: source/Toolbox gate (_surface_from_source), bounds parsing (_surface_window_from_bounds), validation (_surface_window_rect), coordinate-map compilation (_surface_coordinate_map), capture clamping (_clamped_surface_window), composer mapping (_composer_capture_point), in-capture bounds check (_point_inside_capture) and payload construction (_surface_target_payload). Validation order, thresholds, payload keys and the re-exported public API are unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the pipeline inlines back into jetbrains_chat_target_from_surface.
